definitions.first_action: First logged action; STOP if no action is logged.
definitions.full_action_sequence: Logged nonterminal action names followed by the implicit terminal STOP, including STOP at the deadline.
definitions.timed_action_sequence: Action name and completed discrete slot, plus final STOP and submitted_after/dt.
definitions.answer: Submitted answer at that query, before owner target scoring.
definitions.observation_sequence: Logged READ/REFRESH action, completed slot and observed token; WAIT gives no observation.
definitions.equal_recorded_prefix_before_query: All previous query action-slot-token records match; common public writes, query keys, times and costs are separately checked. This is a descriptive trace condition, not a randomization claim.
definitions.entire_query_trace: Complete raw query dictionaries, including posterior checkpoint hashes and scorer outcomes.
definitions.denominator: 8 fitted seeds x 128 episodes x 6 queries = 6144 per domain for every requested valid-arm pair.
definitions.statistical_unit: The independent inferential unit remains the paired fit seed (8), not any of the 6144 correlated query records.

limitations: Earlier arm actions can change later public observations and posterior states; raw trajectory differences are descriptive, not same-prefix causal effects.
Different learned feature arms share a one-action policy class; comparing them with D also changes control scope.
The mean_value arm is invalid on observed-support failures; no successful-subset comparison is computed.
Zero action difference does not imply identical posterior distributions or future equivalence on untested histories.
No new seeds, controller fitting, outcome-based selection, or primary-statistics changes occurred.
Entire-query-trace differences include checkpoint identity/projection metadata; they are not posterior-only differences.
